WITH item_town_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ili.order_item_id,
    c.town_city,
    AVG(ili.product_price) as avg_product_price,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0 
      THEN ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost 
      ELSE NULL 
    END) as avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_stats AS (
  SELECT
    town_city,
    AVG(avg_product_price) as town_avg_price,
    AVG(avg_ratio) as town_avg_ratio
  FROM item_town_stats
  GROUP BY town_city
),
global_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(town_avg_ratio) as global_avg_ratio
  FROM town_stats
)
SELECT
  ts.town_city,
  ts.town_avg_price,
  ts.town_avg_ratio,
  ts.town_avg_ratio - gs.global_avg_ratio as ratio_excess
FROM town_stats ts
CROSS JOIN global_stats gs
WHERE ts.town_avg_ratio > gs.global_avg_ratio
ORDER BY ts.town_city

assumptions.assumption: Division by zero in ratio calculation (derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost) is handled by returning NULL, which AVG() then ignores; similarly, NULL product_price values are skipped by AVG().
Global average ratio is computed as the average of town-level averages (each town weighted equally), rather than as a direct average of all per-item ratios.
